\section[(dialogue)]{Places and things in the house — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R130-first-pass-places-and-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for thunder and lightning.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sack, a box, a cushion, a blanket, a napkin
  \item a spoon, a cooking pot, a dish, a bowl, a candle
  \item a nail, a hammer, a saw, an axe, a ladder
  \item a vessel, a two-handled jar, a flask, a purse, a coin
  \item a book, ink, a reed pen, wax; a wax tablet, a picture
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sack? (\textbf{saccus, saccī}.) A box? (\textbf{cista, cistae}.) A cushion? (\textbf{pulvīnus, pulvīnī}.) A blanket? (\textbf{strāgulum, strāgulī}.) A napkin? (\textbf{mappa, mappae}.) A spoon? (\textbf{cochlear, cochleāris}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{ōlla, ōllae}.) A dish? (\textbf{patina, patinae}.) A bowl? (\textbf{catīnus, catīnī}.) A candle? (\textbf{candēla, candēlae}.) A nail? (\textbf{clāvus, clāvī}.) A hammer? (\textbf{malleus, malleī}.) A saw? (\textbf{serra, serrae}.) An axe? (\textbf{secūris, secūris}.) A ladder? (\textbf{scālae, scālārum}.) A vessel? (\textbf{vās, vāsis}.) A two-handled jar? (\textbf{amphora, amphorae}.) A flask? (\textbf{lagoena, lagoenae}.) A purse? (\textbf{crumēna, crumēnae}.) A coin? (\textbf{nummus, nummī}.) A book? (\textbf{cōdex, cōdicis}.) Ink? (\textbf{ātrāmentum, ātrāmentī}.) A reed pen? (\textbf{calamus, calamī}.) Wax; a wax tablet? (\textbf{cēra, cērae}.) A picture? (\textbf{pictūra, pictūrae}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things you use — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R130-second-pass-things-you-use}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a statue and a sign.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a statue, a sign, a sail; a curtain, a wagon, a long dress
  \item a cloak, a belt, a fruit, an onion, garlic
  \item a bean, a pea, a cucumber, a chicken, pepper
  \item a flat cake, beer, juice, a rose, a lily
  \item a branch, a tree trunk, a seed, a rock, a river bank
  \item a wave, ice, hail, thunder, lightning
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A statue? (\textbf{statua, statuae}.) A sign? (\textbf{signum, signī}.) A sail; a curtain? (\textbf{vēlum, vēlī}.) A wagon? (\textbf{plaustrum, plaustrī}.) A long dress? (\textbf{stola, stolae}.) A cloak? (\textbf{pallium, palliī}.) A belt? (\textbf{zōna, zōnae}.) A fruit? (\textbf{pōmum, pōmī}.) An onion? (\textbf{cēpa, cēpae}.) Garlic? (\textbf{ālium, āliī}.) A bean? (\textbf{faba, fabae}.) A pea? (\textbf{pīsum, pīsī}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{cucumis, cucumeris}.) A chicken? (\textbf{pullus, pullī}.) Pepper? (\textbf{piper, piperis}.) A flat cake? (\textbf{placenta, placentae}.) Beer? (\textbf{cervīsia, cervīsiae}.) Juice? (\textbf{sūcus, sūcī}.) A rose? (\textbf{rosa, rosae}.) A lily? (\textbf{līlium, līliī}.) A branch? (\textbf{rāmus, rāmī}.) A tree trunk? (\textbf{truncus, truncī}.) A seed? (\textbf{sēmen, sēminis}.) A rock? (\textbf{saxum, saxī}.) A river bank? (\textbf{rīpa, rīpae}.) A wave? (\textbf{unda, undae}.) Ice? (\textbf{glaciēs, glaciēī}.) Hail? (\textbf{grandō, grandinis}.) Thunder? (\textbf{tonitrus, tonitrūs}.) Lightning? (\textbf{fulgur, fulguris}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
